Conversation and text-history pagination, paged message search, direct/group texts, encrypted media upload, and guarded My Story publication are implemented. Direct EEL and group TLS-only JPEG snap delivery are live-validated. Incoming friend requests, public profile lookup, own story status reads, and bounded inbox polling are implemented. Owned story metadata is implemented but awaits live validation. Scheduled text batches, service logout, incoming SSE pages, and group request preparation are implemented. Remote story feed listing/deletion and other unvalidated operations remain unavailable.
